title: Knowledge gap record
description: One line of a runtime gaps.jsonl. Written by the answering runtime when it could not answer from certified knowledge, or by a person registering a lead. A gap is a lead, never a card.

registered_by.description: Never a user identifier. The runtime keeps the requester mapping outside the record.

answered.description: Whether an answer was given at all. Required so that 'answered wrongly' and 'could not answer' are never confused.

kind.description: coverage-gap and template-failure are mutually exclusive: one means knowledge is missing, the other means knowledge exists but the compiled artifact failed.

searched.description: Evidence that retrieval was attempted, so a ranking miss can be told apart from missing knowledge.

confidence.description: narrated: said in conversation and unverified; it may justify a ticket but never a card.
